text:
Alex: FYI - seeing dedicated capacity flapping in eu-west since ~06:10 UTC. Multiple tenants (VectorPay, Fleetnova) hit 429s and p95 latency spikes. Autoscaler did 4 scale events (up/down) in ~15m. Paging SRE.
Priya: digging into metrics now. quick chart: https://grafana.redwood/eu-west/d/abcd/autoscale?orgId=1 p95 and desired_replicas line show the sawtooth pattern.
Jamal: probable pattern: auth failures -> client retries -> sudden request burst -> queueing -> p95 jump -> autoscaler scales up -> retries finish -> rate collapses -> scales down. Classic retry-loop noisy neighbor.
Mei: repro steps I ran (local):
```
# simulate stale token + aggressive client retry
for i in {1..200}; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer badtoken" https://dedicated-vectorpay.redwood/api/v1/predict &
done
```
Result: auth-proxy emitted many 401s, some clients treat as retryable and resend -> proxy logs show brief CPU spike and upstream 502s.
ops-bot: incident INC-2345 created (P2) by Alex. Notifying on-call.
Priya: also saw a flurry of 502/504 from the model pool immediately after the auth spike. Looks like a short overload not a model OOM. Token service shows a 15s outage window (requests queued/timeouts).
Alex: CS flagged billing anomalies for VectorPay — duplicate requests caused multiple billable calls. Support ticket #7849 opened; CS-Bot flagged it.
CS-Bot: support ticket 7849 created and linked to INC-2345. Customer requests billing hold.
Jamal: short-term mitigations:
- apply temporary scale-down cooldown = 600s to affected dedicated pools (prevent immediate collapse)
- add a 60s smoothing window on p95 to avoid reacting to 1-min spikes
- throttle aggressive retrying clients at the proxy (rate-limit per token)
Long-term:
- change heavy RPC autoscaler metric from p95 -> p90 for latency
- add derivative smoothing (alpha ~ 0.3)
- circuit-breaker + token refresh fallback in auth-proxy so 401s don't become retry storms
Priya: I rolled the cooldown change to canary pool at eu-west-1: `kubectl -n redwood set env autoscaler COOLDOWN_SCALE_DOWN=600 --context=canary-eu` will monitor.
infra-bot: Canary rollout launched to eu-west-1 (canary-pool). commit abc123. 3/3 pods updated.
Mei: deployed auth-proxy fallback patch to canary (env AUTH_BACKOFF=enabled). Patch makes token-check failures return 503 to clients that honor backoff.
Priya: early signals after canary: p95 fell ~40% and scale churn stopped for ~12m. No new 429s reported from VectorPay.
Alex: confirmed CS paused billing for affected tenants. Customer notified. I'll keep the incident open for 2h observation.
Jamal: action items for postmortem: add autoscaler unit test that injects retry storms, add tenant-level max_burst config, update runbook to include auth-service dependency check before scaling.
Mei: creating PRs for the runbook and the cooldown change. Will tag you two for review.
Alex: thanks team. Great fast triage. :thumbsup:
